message.content: This case concerns whether maintenance can record the replacement kiosk screen as tested. Claim B, that ticket P3 was issued Friday, is well supported by the maintenance log (S2). Claim C, that ticket P3 concerns the south gate kiosk, is contradicted by ticket details identifying it as for the east gate kiosk (S1). Claim A, that the replacement screen passed the midday brightness test, remains unresolved. The parts invoice (S3) lists a nominal brightness rating and notes the ticket was automatically completed after invoice ingestion, implying testing occurred but not confirming the screen passed the midday brightness test. Thus, while maintenance issued the ticket and it relates to the east gate kiosk, there is insufficient evidence to confirm the replacement screen passed the brightness test.
